gloss: to have a discerning eye; to know quality

definitions.gloss: to have a discerning eye; to have good taste; to know quality
definitions.explanation: To be able to tell what is genuinely good or valuable. Often said as praise to a customer who has picked a fine item.

examples.japanese: お{目|め}が{高|たか}いです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{目|め}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: She has a discerning eye for pottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{目|め}が{高|たか}い。⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧かけて⟦{織|お}った→織る：04373_oru⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧です。
examples.english: You have fine taste to choose that kimono. A craftsman spent a year weaving it.

notes:
⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ here means judgment or the eye for quality. The polite form お{目|め}が{高|たか}い is a set compliment from a shop clerk or host when a customer or guest recognises something of value.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{目|め}が{高|たか}いです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: you have a good eye (a compliment)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{目|め}が{高|たか}い: to have a discerning eye for ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肥|こ}える→肥える：18770_koeru⟧: to develop a trained eye through seeing many good things
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an eye for (people, things) — plainer
- ⟦{目|め}が{利|き}く→目が利く：10097_megakiku⟧: to be a good judge (of antiques, goods)
